title: dsh
intro: The DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`), headless over `dsh --profile headless --json`, on DeepSeek's Anthropic-shaped endpoint through `DEEPSEEK_BASE_URL` and `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`.
notes: The model is set by a config patch (`--patch`) the folder writes each turn; dsh has no model flag.
The session id is read from its `session` event and kept in `$HI_DIR`; later turns pass `--session-id`.
`DSH_PERMISSION_MODE=danger-full-access` runs tools without approval prompts; stdin is closed with `</dev/null` because dsh reads it when the task is omitted.
